create_experiment_dag: create an Experiment object with a directory and state class to anchor a DAG of experimental steps
spawn_experiment_tree: spawn a new experiment tree by calling spawn_new_tree with keyword arguments defining the root state
run_experiment_with_dask: run the experiment graph using dask by calling run with a scheduler like single-threaded
restore_experiment_from_disk: restore a previously saved experiment from disk using Experiment.restore with a directory path
apply_recipe_to_state: apply a Recipe subclass to an ExperimentState to transition it to a new state in the graph
